title: Nabi vs Rasool: Farq Kya Hai?
script: Ye hai Nabi aur ye hai Rasool, aakhir isme farq kya hai? Har Rasool Nabi hota hai... Lekin har Nabi Rasool kyun nahi hota? Nabi pehli shariat ko aage badhate hain aur wahi haasil karte hain. Lekin Rasool nayi aasmani kitab aur nayi shariat ke saath aate hain. Har Rasool ke paas Nayi Shariat hoti hai, jabke Nabi pichli shariat ko aam karte hain. Mazeed videos ke liye follow karein.
